6999 Computing and Data Science

6999 Computing and Data Science

Programme Highlights and Key Features

Computing and Data Science (programme code: 6999) offers the choices of three professional degree programmes: BEng(CompSc), BEng(AI&DataSc) and BASc(AppliedAI). Students will undertake a robust common first-year curriculum in computing, data science, and artificial intelligence, and may freely choose any of the aforesaid programmes* by the end of their first year of study, with no quota restrictions.


The programmes are designed to equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge to excel in the rapidly evolving field of computing, AI, data science, and other emerging technologies. They provide a comprehensive education that prepares students to be leaders in their fields, driving innovation and shaping the future technology.


BEng(CompSc) has been accredited by The Hong Kong Institution of Engineers (HKIE).


*All students will be initially enrolled in BEng(CompSc). At the end of their first year of study, they may choose either BEng(CompSc), BEng(AI&DataSc) or BASc(AppliedAI) as their final degree programme.

The Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science [BEng(CompSc)], the Bachelor of Engineering in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science [BEng(AI&DataSc)], and the Bachelor of Arts & Sciences in Applied Artificial Intelligence [BASc(AppliedAI)] are offered under the same programme code. The three programmes offer a solid foundation and a wide range of courses in advanced topics. They are designed to train students’ problem-solving skills and analytical abilities, ensuring they have the skills to tackle complex challenges in their careers. We offer various learning experiences like hands-on projects and internships in addition to classroom teaching, providing our students with practical experience to supplement theoretical knowledge. The design of our curricula stresses flexibility, allowing students to select from a large variety of discipline electives and pursue a minor study or second major for enrichment purposes, catering the diverse interests and passions of our students.

The Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science [BEng(CompSc)] covers a comprehensive curriculum that includes fundamental concepts such as mathematics, programming languages, algorithms, and data structures, as well as advanced topics such as computer organization, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. Students can specialize in areas such as AI and robotics, cybersecurity, financial computing, systems and networking, and theoretical computer science, and benefit from opportunities for hands-on learning and project-based work.

The Bachelor of Engineering in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science [BEng(AI&DataSc)] covers a broad range of topics related to AI and data science, including mathematics, statistics, programming, and database management systems, as well as advanced topics such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and robotics. The interdisciplinary approach ensures that students develop a strong foundation in essential subjects, enabling them to tackle complex data analysis, design intelligent systems, and develop cutting-edge AI solutions.

The Bachelor of Arts and Sciences in Applied Artificial Intelligence [BASc(AppliedAI)] covers both fundamental and practical knowledge in the design and construction of intelligent systems – skills that are applicable in a variety of career settings. The degree engages problem-based learning to touch on a wide range of courses in computer science, geography, mathematics, psychology, statistics, and urban studies. The programme consists of five focus areas, including AI technology, AI in business and finance, AI in medicine, AI in smart cities, and AI in neurocognitive science. Students will be exceptionally well-equipped to create AI products with impact across diverse industries.

Course category BEng(CompSc) BEng(AI&DataSc)
UG 5 Requirements 54 credits 54 credits
Foundation Courses 36 credits 36 credits
Disciplinary Core Courses (Introductory) 24 credits 24 credits
Disciplinary Core Courses (Advanced) 30 credits 30 credits
Capstone Experience (Final Year Project and Internship) 18 credits 18 credits
Disciplinary Elective Courses 36 credits 36 credits
Elective Courses 42 credits 42 credits
Total 240 credits 240 credits

 

Please click here for the syllabuses:

BEng(CompSc) | BEng(AI&DataSc) | BASc(AppliedAI)

Students will have the opportunity to participate in internship and final-year project, where they can apply their skills and knowledge in a real-world setting or solve a specific problem in the field. Students can also apply to undertake a research study under the guidance of a professor through the research fellowship scheme. Students will learn to transfer interdisciplinary scientific knowledge into a wide range of integrated applications and technological innovations to develop the intellectual capacity essential for meeting new challenges and resolving new problems in the future.

[BEng(CompSc)] has been accredited by The Hong Kong Institution of Engineers (HKIE). Following graduation, students will be eligible to apply for professional recognition with the HKIE.

Graduates of the three programmes are well equipped to drive innovation and make significant contribution to the development of cutting-edge solutions in computing, artificial intelligence, and data science. Through their undergraduate studies, they develop strong analytical and problem-solving skills that are highly valued across a wide range of industries.

With strong market demand for their expertise, graduates enjoy excellent career prospects in roles such as machine learning engineer, software developer, data scientist, business analyst, data engineer, AI consultant, cybersecurity specialist, and more. They are sought after by organisations across sectors including banking and finance, government, education, information technology, and telecommunications. Many of our graduates have gone on to work for leading global companies, including Apple and Google, while others have successfully launched their own ventures as entrepreneurs. Our programmes also provide a solid foundation for students who aspire to pursue postgraduate studies and advanced research in computing, AI, and data science.
